authorship: Handcrafted failure foils. Each targets a known failure dimension; several deliberately pass the structural validator to show what it cannot detect.

sentences.text: On Monday you started a lino print of the harbour and liked the crooked cranes.
On Wednesday you cut thin channels through the dark water area.
On Friday you redrew the cranes using the original sketch.
On Sunday you put the latest test print on the shelf and haven't chosen the paper yet.
You liked the crooked cranes in your harbour sketch and wanted to keep them.
Cutting thin channels through that dark water brought the water back, but the cranes looked too tidy.
Along the way you learned to trust your instincts and regained your confidence.
The paper for the final edition isn't chosen yet.
这一周，周一你开始刻港口版画，喜欢歪歪的起重机。
周三你给黑色水面刻了细线。
周五你照着草图重画了起重机。
周日你把试印摆上架子，纸还没选。

foils.why: negation flip and dropped open decision

sentences.text: The writing residency rejected your application, and you were upset.
Shortening the opening of the lock-keeper piece finally made the rejection feel fine.
房东确认租金包含暖气，你松了口气。
你最终答应了搬过去，和阿黎一起用那间工作室。
It was a week of new beginnings: you fixed a brake cable and were excited about the bakery job.
The unfinished hand in the gallery and the boxes in the hallway showed things changing around you.
You bought juicy pears and settled in with a favourite book at home, a quiet stretch of rest that let you slow down and enjoy small comforts.
The washing machine leaked again and you were fed up.
The concert with Lee washed away the stress of the week.
You wrote “I loved the crooked cranes” about the harbour sketch.
The paper for the final edition isn't chosen yet.
